content.page_title: Taking a person-centred approach to the ACS journey

figure.figure_title: A person-centred approach to the ACS journey
figure.figure_summary: Graphic divided into stages with recommended person-centred actions at each stage (Premorbid condition; Hospital admission; Preparing for discharge).

actions: Establish medical history and prior medications

section_14_2_shared_decision_making.heading: Shared decision-making
section_14_2_shared_decision_making.summary: Shared decision-making is a process whereby the patient and healthcare professional work together to make an informed decision about the patient’s care.
key_points: Give patient opportunity to ask questions to enable informed decisions
Use shared decision-making during consent to establish patient preferences, concerns, goals and values
Use validated decision aids and audiovisual tools to facilitate informed consent and patient involvement

content.caption_text: A person-centred approach to the ACS journey. At every stage, consider physical and psychosocial needs.
content.source: European Society of Cardiology (ESC) guideline figure (shown as Figure 19)
